messages:
oncall-bot: Incident detected: high CPU usage on inference-nodes-uk-*, tokenization pipeline spike. Severity: pages

sara.nguyen: I'm getting paged, looking now. seeing repeated container restarts on tokenizer-service pods in eu-west-2.

lee_hwang: logs show "killed process due to OOM" and kernel OOM events. also CUDA errors on one node: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` interleaved.

anita.k: Confirmed multiple nodes flapping. CPU usage at 100% for kubelet + tokenizer process. Affected: customer-facing hosted model endpoints (chat), some 5% of requests 500.

mike_randall: Assigning priority P1? customers seeing 500s and elevated latency. Paging infra and prod-eng.

infra-bot: PagerDuty alert routed to @infra-team, escalation: first responder @mike_randall

mike_randall: I'm on it. first steps: cordon problematic nodes, drain to stop further evictions. Also scale down tokenizer replicas to 0 to stop storm while we stabilize.

sara.nguyen: running commands:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep tokenizer
kubectl cordon node/inference-node-42
kubectl drain node/inference-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --force
kubectl scale deploy tokenizer-service -n inference --replicas=0
```

lee_hwang: logs from tokenizer:
```
[2026-03-14T18:10:02Z] token_processor.cpp: alloc 8.0GB failed
[2026-03-14T18:10:02Z] runtime: killed process 1234 (tokenizer) sigkill
```

anita.k: We see a sudden surge of very long prompts (thousands tokens) from a small set of clients causing repeated full-buffer tokenization and K/V cache thrash.

mike_randall: Mitigation plan: 1) apply rate-limit on route to throttle bursty clients 2) temporarily disable streaming tokenization to use chunked streaming 3) revert last prompt parsing change from yesterday's deploy if it's related.

sara.nguyen: Pushing rate-limit config to envoy:
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it envoy-control -- envoy-admin set-rate-limit route tokenizer 50r/s
```

lee_hwang: Also adding an admission webhook to reject requests > 4k tokens until we patch. patch will stream-tokenize in smaller increments.

anita.k: Customer impact note: ~8 customer orgs impacted; approx 2.7% of hosted API requests get 502/500 during spike windows. No data exfil.

mike_randall: Rolling restart of remaining tokenizer pods after drain + new config. spinning up 2 replicas with limit cpu=2, memory=6Gi. starting now.

infra-bot: Deploy successful: tokenizer-service v2.14.3 rolled back to v2.14.1 (last known good)

sara.nguyen: Monitoring: CPU back to ~40% on recovered nodes, error rate dropping. Keeping throttles in place for 30m.

lee_hwang: Creating follow-ups: (1) patch tokenizer lib to stream-tokenize large inputs (2) add token-count precheck in the edge (3) autoscale policy tweak for sudden bursts (4) add clearer client guidance.

mike_randall: Handoff: I'm going offline in 10m. @lee_hwang you take oncall. If anything recurs, escalate to @anita.k then @sre-lead. Leaving notes in incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/1758647000

lee_hwang: taking over. will monitor for next 2 hours. opening postmortem stub.

sara.nguyen: Thanks team :thumbsup: will add customer comms draft and timeline.

oncall-bot: On-call handoff recorded. new primary: lee_hwang. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
